The [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Cy Yunga]] flew a '''Podracer''' pulled by a pair of [[Color/Legends|red]], white, and yellow [[Hummel Carbine]] [[V-71 Ridge Piranha]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Engineer/Legends|engines]] during the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. Yunga flew the pod while acting as the a track favorite for the [[Sunken City/Legends|Sunken City]] [[Podracing/Legends|race course]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquilaris]], and at one point piloted the craft during a Podrace on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. Eventually, at least one of Yunga's identifiable engines made its way to a Tatooine [[Wald's Parts|junkyard]] owned by the [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]].

==Description==
[[File:V-71_Ridge_Piranha.jpg|thumb|left|175px|Yunga's Podracer utilized a pair of V-71 Ridge Piranha engines.]]
During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC1" /> the professional [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Cy Yunga]] flew a flamboyantly painted [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] characterized by the [[Color/Legends|red]], white, and yellow [[Comet/Legends|comet]]-esque designs painted on the broadsides of the two<ref name="E1R" /> [[Hummel Carbine]] [[V-71 Ridge Piranha]] race [[Engine/Legends|engines]]<ref name="Insider" /> that pulled the [[Missile/Legends|rocket]]-shaped [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]].<ref name="E1R" />

The [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] featured tight turning capabilities and sported a moderately slow working [[Accelerator/Legends|accelerator]] that would, in time, push the vehicle to a high top speed. The cockpit was a single-seater with a hull painted in red and yellow. The cockpit also featured a jagged fin immediately behind the seating area, and had two engine-shaped devices on the port and starboard sides. The cockpit was tathered to both engines by a pair of [[control cable]]s, which in turn were tethered together by [[Energy binder/Legends|energy binders]].<ref name="E1R" />

==History==
[[File:Cy_Yunga_Podrace.png|thumb|right|200px|Cy Yunga pilots his Podracer on Tatooine.]]
Cy Yunga utilized his V-71 pulled Podracer<ref name="E1R" /> during the year 32 BBY,<ref name="NEC1" /> a year which saw Yunga sharing the title of track favorite of the [[Sunken City/Legends|Sunken City]] [[Podracing/Legends|race course]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aquilaris]] with [[Navior|"Bullseye" Navior]].<ref name="E1R" /> At some point, Yunga flew the Podracer during a race on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] against a score of seasoned competitors including [[Wan Sandage/Legends|Wan Sandage]], [[Mawhonic/Legends|Mawhonic]], the pro-league rookiee [[Ben Quadinaros/Legends|Ben Quadinaros]], and the [[Ord Ibanna]] champion [[Bozzie Baranta]].<ref name="E1RP">[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Racer'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

Eventually, one of Cy Yunga's easily identifiable engines ended up in a Tatooine [[Wald's Parts|junkyard]] owned by the [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Junk dealer/Legends|junk dealer]] [[Watto/Legends|Watto]], who often dealt in Podracer parts and components.<ref name="E1R" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cy Yunga and his Podracer was selectable for play only if the player entered the code '''RRCYYUN''' or '''RRTANGENTABACUS''' on the [[Wikipedia:Nintendo 64|Nintendo 64]] version of the [[1999]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I Racer|Star Wars Episode I: Racer]]''. Upon entry, Cy Yunga fully replaces [[Navior|"Bullsye" Navior]]. In the [[Sega]] [[Wikipedia:Dreamcast|Dreamcast]] version of the [[Star Wars video games|game]], one of Yunga's V-71 engines,<ref name="E1R" /> identified as such only in the ''Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide'',<ref name="Insider" /> appear only in Watto's junkyard.<ref name="E1R" /> In the PC version of the game, unlock Cy Yunga by pressing Left-Ctrl, C and Y together on the character select screen.
